<?php

if (empty($from_code) || $from_code == 'xx') {
   $from_code = '';
}
else {
   $from_code = '&source=' . $from_code;
}
$encoded = drupal_encode_path($input);
$contype = 'text/plain';
$google_service = 'https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2';
$api_key = trim(variable_get('rovas_google_translate_api_key', ''));
if ($api_key === '') {
	echo 'error';
	watchdog('rule', 'rules_google_translate_text missing Google Translate API key.');
	return;
}

$url = $google_service . '?key=' . $api_key . '&q=' . $encoded . '&target=' . $to_code . '&source=' . $from_code;

global $base_url;

$rest_call = drupal_http_request($url, array(
    'headers' => array(
        'Content-Type' => $contype,
        'Referer' => $base_url . '/',
    ),
    'method' => 'POST',
    'timeout' => 5,
));

if (isset($rest_call->code) && $rest_call->code == 200) {
	$kuk = json_decode($rest_call->data);
	echo $kuk->data->translations[0]->translatedText;
}
else {
	echo 'error';
watchdog('rule','rules_google_translate_text 1' . print_r($rest_call,1));
}

?>
